summary: Copies suspension datasets into the physics engine via SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine. First two copies use wheel 0 and wheel 1 suspension pointers; remaining two copies branch on a shared suspension ID selector at this[1287] — when set, both share that ID as source, otherwise each wheel uses its own suspension pointer (this[813], this[1094]). Returns the result of the final copy.

operations.description: Branch on shared suspension selector this[1287]: non-zero selects the shared suspension ID for the remaining wheel copies; zero selects per-wheel suspension IDs.
Shared-ID path: SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine(dest=this+1006, source=this[1287]) and return its result.
Per-wheel path: SuspensionDataCopyToPhysicsEngine(dest=this+1006, source=this[1094]) and return its result.
